I flew to "MoonFall PSR landing (synthetic)" at -89.71°, -2°. It's a synthetic mission waypoint, not an observed landing. It is separate from the Shackleton crater place record (-89.67°, 129.78°) and the "Shackleton Overview" viewpoint.

The Moon has streamed terrain, built from LOLA 118 m and south-pole 10 m height data. It also has cube imagery, a LROC WAC 100 m and NAC south-pole 1 m composite. Both are loaded and drawn, with no failed requests. Base, normal and displacement textures are configured, but their source and load state are unknown. There are no managed overlay layers. Current-view coverage is unknown.
